name: Tentacool (CobbleEffort form)
look: a little deep-sea squid: a purple mantle with glowing blue ring photophores and a spiky tip, a yellow head with big slit-pupilled yellow eyes, short arms and two long tentacles with hooked ring clubs
entry: It lives in the dark of the deep sea, where it lures prey with the blue rings glowing on its mantle. The hooked rings on its two long tentacles never let go of what they catch.
how: Wild: uncommon in the depths of deep oceans (mostly in the dark, far below the surface).
Evolves into the CobbleEffort Tentacruel at level 30.
